messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: P0 fired — DB/Cache connection pressure in prod (eu-west). Alert: pgbouncer_pool_waits > 1000, redis maxclients errors rising. Auto-page to oncall.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Notification sent to maria (primary oncall). Incident URL: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD12345

maria: acked :white_check_mark: I'm taking this. First pass: is this a spike or sustained? collecting metrics.

devon: I'm seeing a sudden ramp from inference-proxy-4 to our DB and cache. 1m QPS to embeddings endpoints jumped x6 at 07:02 UTC. pgbouncer shows massive waiters.

maria: putting pgbouncer stats here:

```
$ echo "SHOW POOLS" | psql pgbouncer
database | cl_active | cl_waiting | sv_active | sv_idle | pool_mode
app_db   | 480       | 1240       | 200       | 5       | transaction
```

maria: Redis client info:

```
# redis-cli -h cache-prod-1 INFO clients
connected_clients:1024
maxclients:1024
blocked_clients:0
```

raj: seeing Redis logs: "ERR max number of clients reached" across cache-prod-1 and cache-prod-2. Likely short-lived connection storm from workers not reusing pools.

kate: Replays from LB show a traffic fanout from a small set of inference VMs (inference-proxy) — they started re-trying on 5xx and are creating new connections instead of pooling.

maria: customer impact: embeddings/semantic-search endpoints returning 502/503 for ~12% of requests in eu-west, timeout errors in logs. No data corruption.

devon: quick mitigations I'd recommend: 1) throttle incoming traffic at API gateway for embeddings route; 2) bump pgbouncer max_client_conn temporarily; 3) set Redis maxclients higher on cache nodes (careful) OR restart pooled workers to free sockets.

maria: executing mitigation plan: applying rate-limit rule now to inference-prod route (burst 100, rate 50/s) — will reduce amplification. I'll also open a bump request to infra to increase pgbouncer max_client_conn from 500 to 800 for app_db.

sam: +1 to throttling. On Redis side, prefer to restart the misbehaving workers first. If we raise maxclients, we risk exhausting file descriptors. Can we identify the offending instances to restart?

kate: tagging the inference team: @dev-team — please check inference-proxy-3/4/7 for pool reuse bug. Seen repeated connect/open calls in the last 3 mins.

dev-team (automated): acknowledged by dev-team lead. Rolling restart of inference-proxy-4 in progress (graceful drain).

maria: infra confirmed pgbouncer config change queued and applied on one pool host (pgbouncer-1): now max_client_conn=800. Monitoring for dropping waiters.

```
# watch -n 2 "echo \"SHOW POOLS\" | psql pgbouncer | grep app_db"
app_db | cl_active: 420 | cl_waiting: 200 | sv_active: 210
```

maria: waiters dropped from 1240 -> ~200 after throttle + pgbouncer bump + proxy restart. Redis still at maxclients on cache-prod-1, but cache-prod-2 cleared after restart of worker group.

raj: restarted the worker pool on cache-prod-1: connections dropped to 120/1024. No further ERR logs. Adding a short-term circuit-breaker on embed endpoints for noisy tenants.

devon: I pushed a temporary feature-flag to the API to route large-embedding requests to a lower-concurrency path (degrades throughput but lowers connection churn). Should reduce recurrence.

maria: customer update draft: "We've mitigated an incident causing elevated 502/503s for embeddings in eu-west. Throttling and pool adjustments have reduced errors; teams are investigating root cause. We'll follow up with timeline and remediation." Any edits?

kate: looks good. Add "no customer data exposure" line.

maria: sending outage summary to status page and starting a post-incident ping for next 2 hours for regression detection.

sam: I'll take handoff at 08:30 UTC. Current state: error rate ~1.5% (was 12%), waiters down, Redis recovered. If anything spikes again, ping me directly and re-page.

maria: handing off to sam — summary for handoff: throttled embeddings, bumped pgbouncer to 800, restarted two worker pools, dev-team rolling restart of misbehaving proxies, temporary route fallback live. Follow-up actions: look at connection pooling in inference-proxy, add better client socket reuse, harden Redis client limits vs FDs, run a replay test.

sam: acked :handshake: will own the follow-ups and the postmortem. tagging oncall-secondary kate for visibility.

incident-bot: Incident P0 acknowledged by maria, handoff to sam at 08:30 UTC. Ticket: #INC-2026-042

maria: resolving my PD acknowledgement. Marking as mitigated for primary. :thumbsup:

sam: closing thread for now, will create postmortem draft and link to this thread. If any regressions occur, re-open.
